newsitem.title: USA: Home Bancorp to buy back 10 pct of stock.
newsitem.headline: Home Bancorp to buy back 10 pct of stock.

text.p: Home Bancorp said Wednesday it intends to repurchase 10 percent of its common stock.

The repurchase plan will begin on or after December 23, the company said, and is planned to be completed over the next 12 months. Purchases will be made at market prices, from time to time depending on market conditions.
The repurchased shares will be held as treasury stock and will be used for general corporate purposes, the company said.
Home Bancorp also said it has completed the repurchase plan announced in July. It bought back five percent or 139,617 shares at an average price of $17.42 a share.
